synsets.definition: a hand tool with a thin flexible blade used to mix or spread soft substances
synsets.name: spatula

synsets.definition: a screwdriver with a ratchet (so the blade turns in only one direction) and a spiral in the handle (so the blade rotates) with downward pressure on the handle
synsets.name: spiral ratchet screwdriver

synsets.definition: a small plane that has a handle on each side of its blade; used for shaping or smoothing cylindrical wooden surfaces (originally wheel spokes)
synsets.name: spokeshave

synsets.definition: a hand tool for spreading something
synsets.name: spreader

synsets.definition: a sharp hand shovel for digging out roots and weeds
synsets.name: spud

synsets.definition: a hand tool consisting of two straight arms at right angles; used to construct or test right angles
synsets.name: square

synsets.definition: a large pipe wrench with L-shaped adjustable jaws that tighten as pressure on the handle is increased
synsets.name: Stillson wrench

synsets.definition: hand tool consisting of a flat rigid rectangular bar (metal or wood) that can be used to draw straight lines (or test their straightness)
synsets.name: straightedge

synsets.definition: a wrench with an S-shaped handle
synsets.name: S wrench

synsets.definition: a light hammer that is used to drive tacks
synsets.name: tack hammer

synsets.definition: a file with converging edges
synsets.name: taper file

synsets.definition: a wrench for turning a tap to create an internal screw thread
synsets.name: tap wrench

synsets.definition: hand tool consisting of a lever that is used to force the casing of a pneumatic tire onto a steel wheel
synsets.name: tire iron

synsets.definition: pick consisting of a small strip of wood or plastic; used to pick food from between the teeth
synsets.name: toothpick

synsets.definition: a wrench that has a gauge that indicates the amount of torque being applied
synsets.name: torque wrench

synsets.definition: a plumber's snake for clearing a trap and drain
synsets.name: trap-and-drain auger

synsets.definition: a small hand tool with a handle and flat metal blade; used for scooping or spreading plaster or similar materials
synsets.name: trowel

synsets.definition: a square having a metal ruler set at right angles to another straight piece
synsets.name: try square

synsets.definition: a square used by draftsmen to draw parallel lines
synsets.name: T-square

synsets.definition: a saw with handles at both ends; intended for use by two people
synsets.name: two-handed saw

synsets.definition: a hand tool for removing weeds
synsets.name: weeder

synsets.definition: a hand tool used by electricians to remove insulation from the cut end of an insulated wire
synsets.name: wire stripper

synsets.definition: a hand tool that is used to hold or twist a nut or bolt
synsets.name: wrench

synsets.definition: a wrench for Allen screws
synsets.name: zeta key

synsets.definition: A hooked tool, usually of metal, used to clean the hooves of a horse; some designs include a small, very stiff brush for removing additional mud or dirt.
synsets.name: hoof pick

synsets.definition: a hand tool used for joining two pieces of metal or other ductile material (usually a wire and a metal plate) by deforming one or both of them to hold the other.
synsets.name: crimper

synsets.definition: a small backsaw used to cut dovetails.
synsets.name: dovetail saw

synsets.definition: a hand tool with polished agate tips (or other gemstone) for rubbing the gold leaf in order to obtain a highly polished surface, used in gilding.
synsets.name: burnisher

synsets.definition: a weeder with steel claws that grab weeds by the root for clean removal.
synsets.name: weed puller
